title: Rooftop identification
slide_intent: Translate a screen-oriented dimensional form into physical signage so it remains identifiable in its surroundings.
strategic_value: A consistent symbol and wordmark can connect Swisscom’s built environment with its printed and digital identity.
demonstration: A low-angle photograph shows the red-and-blue symbol beside large dark blue Swisscom letters on a rooftop, with support posts and an overcast sky visible.
practical_value: Compare symbol, lettering, support structure and sky as one sign composition rather than evaluating the logo in isolation.

content_islands.name: Symbol and wordmark sign
content_islands.spec: Place the dimensional symbol to the left of the large freestanding wordmark and preserve the photographed alignment.

content_islands.name: Roof and supports
content_islands.spec: Retain the roof edge, support posts and small human figure beneath the lettering as physical-scale evidence.

content_islands.name: Sky backdrop
content_islands.spec: Keep the pale overcast sky behind the sign so its silhouette and depth remain visible.

reference_purposes.Expression: The colored symbol and blue wordmark become dimensional architectural objects.
reference_purposes.Application: The rooftop photograph demonstrates the identity mounted at building scale.
